tagline: We help pediatricians pass the boards, even if they've been struggling for years.
title: Meet our founder,
name: Dr. Jordan Avery
bio: After a difficult first attempt at the pediatric boards, Dr. Jordan Avery rebuilt their study approach around efficiency, structure and repetition. That experience became the foundation of PedsReady: a step-by-step system designed to help pediatricians study smarter, practice with purpose and walk into exam day prepared.
note: Dr. Jordan Avery is a fictional founder created for this demo.
